Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 91. Category: form. Energy of Sesa’s Family.

Rank 4 Power-Up
You gain a coat of demonic energy as you draw
directly upon your connection to Sesa.
Increase your Power by 3
Increase your Movement Speed by 15 ft.
You gain an additional +1 Power to Spells and Ki
Techniques
You may cast spells from the infernal legacy feature
as a bonus action on your turn.
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
